Energy = Power × Time; optimizations that reduce either average power draw OR execution time (or both) are valid. (7) Do NOT change the program's command-line interface or output format. ENERGY OPTIMIZATION STRATEGIES: (A) Global memory coalescing: ensure threads in a warp access consecutive addresses. (B) Shared memory: cache frequently re-read global memory into __shared__. (C) Read-only cache: use __ldg() or const __restrict__ for read-only arrays. (H) Loop unrolling: add #pragma unroll for small inner loops. (I) Minimize synchronization: reduce __syncthreads() to only where strictly required. FORMAT: produce well-formatted C++ code with proper indentation and newlines. Every function body MUST span multiple lines — do NOT compact statements onto a single line.
